review: All secret notes and journal scraps were read directly against English. Twenty-eight readable records were translated, including gift lists, clue wording, Junimo lore, Grandpa's letter, the pirate journal, forge tables, enchantment instructions and verse. Canonical item, person, location and enchantment terminology, note layout, deliberately garbled clue text and every reveal-taste token were checked. Ten image-command records remain exact runtime data.
